ops.body: Branch ready for release: worktree-packs-unify (worktree at .claude/worktrees/packs-unify), HEAD = the docs-limitations commit after 12b51df1. All implementation phases done; two review rounds complete (codex finder: 12 findings → 10 fixed / 2 rejected-with-rationale; codex refuter: 5 invariants broken → all fixed, incl. warm-stdout parity and the shared [pack]-aware manifest resolver). Gates green: full suite exit 0 (3545 collected, 4 by-design sandbox skips), daemon byte-parity 16/16 (now covers stdout), gd-build docs 19/19 (note: bare `great-docs build` no longer works — use `uv run --with "git+https://github.com/yasyf/cc-skills@main#subdirectory=tools/gd-build" gd-build build`), live smoke: pack list 4 builtins, warm snapshot skips the claude CLI (1.75s cold → 0.57s warm). Real installed plugins are correctly invisible until their manifests gain [pack] (rollout step 4 in this task's body). DO NOT tag until fleet pre-staging (step 1-2 of the sequence) is done; merge worktree-packs-unify → main merge-not-rebase; pick the version number against PyPI at tag time (10.0.0 intended).
